literal: From delusion completely separated vision-possessors will not eat from life completely separated flesh.
translation: Those with clear vision, completely freed from delusion, will not eat flesh that has been completely severed from life.
modern: குற்றமற்ற தெளிந்த அறிவுடையவர்கள், உயிரிலிருந்து பிரிந்துபோன உடலாகிய இறைச்சியை உண்ணமாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains that eating meat is incompatible with true wisdom and clarity of mind. The poet describes wise people as those who have completely freed themselves from the blemish of delusion. Such individuals of clear vision will never consume meat, which is defined here simply as substance completely severed from a living being. By showing that a clear mind naturally rejects meat, the verse highlights the connection between mental clarity and compassion toward all life.
